projects.name: ShelfSwap
projects.description: A book-exchange marketplace where students list used textbooks and trade them within their campus. Includes search, wishlists and in-app chat.
highlights: Built REST endpoints for listings, offers and chat threads
Added a debounced search bar with client-side caching

projects.name: CanteenQ
projects.description: Order-ahead web app for a college canteen. Students place orders, staff see a live queue, and pickup tokens are issued in order.
highlights: Designed the order-status dashboard with React hooks
Implemented token deduplication using a hash map on the server
